title: Fix the CSV quote-handling data-loss bug
change: A double-quote opens quoting ONLY when fieldStart is true; otherwise append it as a literal character.
Set fieldStart=true after every delimiter and every row break; false after any other character.
If the loop ends with quoted===true, throw PsIsonoteParseError('UNTERMINATED_QUOTE', row).
Add the three regression tests from the audit verbatim.
exit: cd frontend && npx vitest run src/core/macro/psIsonote/  →  exit 0
New tests must include: literal inch mark preserved; RFC4180 quoted field with embedded delimiter; unterminated quote throws
forbidden: Do NOT add byte/row/cell limits here. That is P3-T01.
Do NOT change cleanCell, detectDelimiter, header aliasing, or any caller.
Do NOT swap in a third-party CSV library.
escalate: An existing test asserts the OLD (buggy) behaviour. Do not delete it — report it; it means a downstream consumer depends on the bug.
